issue.title: test_status_check_is_user_triggered_and_records_observation flakes under the full parallel lane with KeyError 'apollo'
issue.description: Intermittent KeyError in the Machines pane status-check test under full-lane load; see the flake report body.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by phase bead sase-1aq.10.7.5.5 (note #4, 2026-09-27); originally sase-xe.16.11.7 note #3. It failed once under full-parallel-lane load with `KeyError: 'apollo'` and passed 3/3 in isolation. The candidate cause is a race between `_checking_alias` and `_statuses` in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/machines_pane.py: the status map is read for an alias whose check has not recorded an entry yet. Not reproduced in this landing's `sase tool run -k check` (run 109aa65ee68b1d6365d33d297620dfab), so the fail rate is low (about 1 in 4 or fewer observed runs).
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (full parallel lane)

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1aq.10.7.5.5 note #4 during the sase-1aq.10.7.5 landing; no existing task tracks this machines-pane flake.

evidence.note: Relayed phase evidence from sase-1ok.3 note #1: tests/ace/tui/test_machines_pane.py::test_status_check_is_user_triggered_and_records_observation timed out under the full lane in ToolRun c6ba95cd7ec6d1eb0b97d35ed34ec705, classified FLAKY. Same exact load-sensitive status-check node already tracked here; the phase changed bead CLI guards and prompts, not Machines pane behavior. No new task or fresh lander reproduction claimed.
